about.description: USDi is an inflation-indexed USD stablecoin issued by USDi Partners LLC, formed in mid-2024 and based in Basking Ridge, New Jersey. The ERC-20 token tracks the US Not-Seasonally-Adjusted CPI using the TIPS reference-CPI interpolation method against a base CPI of 315.605 (base date March 1, 2025), so each token preserves the purchasing power of a December 2024 dollar. Reserves are invested in the Enduring US Inflation Tracking Fund managed by Enduring Investments, with NAV calculated by independent administrator Trident Fund Services Inc; the issuer claims no securities or money-transmission licenses and no SEC filings for USDi Partners were located on EDGAR.
about.founders: Michael Ashton (Co-Founder), Andrew Fately (Co-Founder, Managing Partner), Roger Ramia (Co-Founder, Technical Lead)
about.regulatoryStatus: No licenses or registrations disclosed; positioned in the whitepaper as a currency, not an investment vehicle. EDGAR full-text search returns no SEC filings for USDi Partners LLC (checked 2026-07). Direct fiat mints/burns above $1mm require KYC/AML with USDi Partners.
about.keyMilestones: 2024: USDi Partners LLC formed mid-2024 | 2025-03: base date Mar 1, 2025 - USDi value $1.000000 against base CPI 315.605 | 2025-04: public launch as ERC-20 on Ethereum; ConsenSys Diligence smart-contract audit published
about.entityStructureNotes: Issuer: USDi Partners LLC, Basking Ridge, New Jersey. Reserves in the Enduring US Inflation Tracking Fund managed by Enduring Investments (Michael Ashton's firm): unlevered US Treasuries, TIPS, FX, commodity futures/options and cash. Administrator: Trident Fund Services Inc (monthly collateral attestation). Auditor contradiction between live sources: website FAQ names Cherry Bekaert LLC while the whitepaper names Spicer Jeffries LLP.

fees.revenueModel: Hybrid - small mint/burn transaction fee plus retention of reserve-fund return in excess of CPI accrual
fees.revenueNotes: Whitepaper discloses a very small transaction fee on public mint/burn (size not published) and that the backing fund has outperformed CPI by roughly 5-13bps per month net of fees; excess return over the CPI-indexed liability accrues to overcollateralization/the issuer. USDi pays no interest to holders. No attestation reports were locatable on the public website despite claims they are posted.
fees.revenueVerificationMethod: USDi whitepaper (IPFS via usdicoin.com), usdicoin.com FAQ and mint page, issuer press release 2025-04-15, SEC EDGAR full-text search
